verdict.rationale: Relay ships automations, including auto-transfer rules and multi-step approval rules, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, change review, or rollback of those automations. The approval rules govern payments, not changes to the automations themselves, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
